hints.title: Running Leader Chronological Precomputation
hints.text: Precompute the leading candidate at every vote timestamp in one forward pass so subsequent point queries reduce to efficient interval lookup.

hints.title: Vote Counting with Recency Tie-Breaking
hints.text: Iterate through votes, maintain candidate vote totals. When a candidate reaches or exceeds the current maximum count, update the leading candidate.

hints.title: TopVotedCandidate Query Blueprint
hints.text: In init: record (time, leader) for every index. In q(t): use binary search on times array to find greatest timestamp <= t, then return corresponding leader.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) init, O(log N) per query
complexity.notes: Linear scan precomputes leader history in O(N); binary search resolves timestamp queries in O(log N).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-counting vote arrays up to time t on every query takes O(N) per query, timing out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing leaders list of length N allows instantaneous retrieval via binary search.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precomputing chronological leader transitions and handling tie-breaking favoring most recent vote.
